name: RBI policy decision
what: Monetary Policy Committee meetings. Use the LAST day of each meeting, which is the day the decision is announced.
why: RBI repo rate and stance decision. Directly affects banks, rate-sensitive sectors and bond yields.

name: US Fed (FOMC) rate decision
time: 2:00 PM New York time (late night in India)
what: FOMC meetings. Use the SECOND day of each meeting, which is the decision day.
why: US interest-rate decision. Can move global markets, the dollar and foreign flows into India.

name: US CPI inflation
what: release dates of the US Consumer Price Index
why: US inflation reading. Shapes expectations for Fed rates and the dollar.
